summary: The inequality and proof are correct, including zero-dimensional and other lower-dimensional cases. Small and boundary cases do not refute the claim. The published Theorem 1.2 on printed page 268 has exactly the stated four-function hypothesis and conclusion; its specialization to the four finite-set indicators at lambda = 1/2 is valid. Coordinate contraction, both rounding maps, their image containments and at-most-2^n fiber bounds are correct, and their combination yields the claimed factor 2^{-n}.
